channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Seven killed in Gaza as Israel targets university campus and other sites
item.description: Israeli air strike kills three security guards in one of two attacks on the Islamic University in Gaza City.

item.title: How is the US-Israeli war on Iran causing havoc in Europe?
item.description: Rising energy costs and protests are sharpening European opposition to renewed US-Israeli attacks on Iran.

item.title: Saudi air defences intercept Houthi barrage near Mecca
item.description: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia escalate as fierce ground battles and a devastating siege strangle Yemen's Taiz.

item.title: CENTCOM reportedly has plans for Iran strikes: Will Trump approve them?
item.description: Reports say Pentagon has drawn up plans for strikes after midterm polls, but analysts question what it could achieve.

item.title: Iran’s authorities take ‘self-sacrifice’ mobilisation campaign nationwide
item.description: The IRGC says it wants to use main squares in every capital of Iran’s 31 provinces for the Janfada campaign.

item.title: Police in Albania filmed beating protester unconscious
item.description: Police in Albania’s capital, Tirana, were filmed beating a protester lying on the ground.

item.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts missiles and drones as fighting with Houthis rages
item.description: Saudi Civil Defence says the interception of Houthi ballistic missiles caused two injuries in the country's south.

item.title: Trump mocks reporter asking about Iran strikes, as Tehran says US derailed
item.description: US President Donald Trump sarcastically responded to a reporter asking about possible renewed attacks on Iran.

item.title: Israel to close West Bank crossings on election day as crackdown escalates
item.description: The Israeli Defense Forces announces restrictions on the movement of Palestinian workers in the run-up to Tuesday's election.

item.title: Gunmen kill at least 10 villagers and loot shops in north-east Nigeria
item.description: Police are searching for other casualties, with officials warning the actual death toll could rise further.
